Existing uniform EAM without learning preserves exact strict order;quantization can collapse ties/zeros but cannot numerically reverse it. Future selective producer witness remains conditional and mechanism-dependent;no per-edge override/new mechanism authorized. Bounded component/internal scheduler evidence,not public source admission,read authorization,Save132 or complete-prefix replay.
